dossier.scp_unleashed.098.title: Parasitic Crabs
dossier.scp_unleashed.098.caption: SCP-098 beside an SCP-098-1 hive, during a feeding trial.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-098-1 is held in a sealed cell floored with bare stone. No sand of any kind is to be brought within thirty metres of the cell, and no livestock is to be kept on site.
Staff entering the cell work in pairs and wear full hazmat suits. **No one is to linger near a mature hive.**

Any instance of SCP-098 found outside the cell is to be destroyed, not recaptured, and the surrounding ground searched for new hives. Staff present during a spore release are held for %robservation period withheld%r before they may leave the site.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-098 is a species of spider crab with a rounded, spined shell of cream and rust orange and eight long, banded walking legs. Two slender claws are carried folded in front of the face. Instances span a little over a metre and a half.

SCP-098-1 is the hive the instances live in: ordinary sand, bound together and bored through with tunnels. A hive grows from a small quantity of seed sand mixed into any sand. It matures over time, and more holes open in its surface as it does.

Instances leave the hive to hunt pigs, sheep, cattle, poultry and similar livestock. They pick the carcass clean where it falls and carry the meal home. They ignore people, unless people strike first.
A mature hive at times breathes out a slow, drifting cloud of yellow spores. Staff caught in a cloud report nothing unusual afterwards. See Addendum 098-2.

page.title: Addendum 098-1: Feeding
page.text: A hive whose residents eat well seldom stays alone. New hives have been found up to thirty metres from the first, always in open sand. %rFeeding trials suspended.%r

page.title: Addendum 098-2: Incident 098-03
text: Over one evening, an agent walked back to the hive cell nine times. He could not say why. On the tenth visit he stopped in the doorway, facing the hive, and complained of pressure behind the eyes. A fully grown instance of SCP-098 emerged from his head, pale as bone, and ran into the hive.
The agent survived. He had walked through a spore release two days before. %rHis examinations had all come back clean.%r

page.title: Addendum 098-3: Provenance
text: SCP-098 was not recovered. Its seed sand was handed to a reader of this file by an individual in Foundation dress, the same individual described in the files of other objects.
The individual said only that the vial was not a sample, and should not be stored as one. %rAsked what it was, he did not answer.%r See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp098_sand_vial.tool: Pale, fine sand under an old cork. It settles a little differently every time you look.
item.scp_unleashed.scp098_sand_vial.use: It seems to want to be with other sand.
item.scp_unleashed.scp098_sand_vial.warn: Whatever it becomes, do not breathe near it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.1: The sand is waiting for you.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.2: Something in you wants to go home.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.3: You remember the way back. You never learned it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.4: There is room for you in the hive.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.5: Your head feels full of sand.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.nudge.6: Go back. It is warm there.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.urge.1: That way. You know which way.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.urge.2: Why are you looking away from home?
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.urge.3: Closer. It is so close now.
message.scp_unleashed.scp098.urge.4: The dark goes away when you go home.
A stoppered glass vial of pale, fine sand, handed over by a stranger in Foundation dress.
Pour it onto a block of sand or red sand and that sand will not stay ordinary. The vial is used up.
It is not a labware sample. Racks, dishes, swabs and analysers will not take it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp098_hive.1: SCP-098-1: sand riddled with tunnels. It matures slowly, and more holes open in it as it does.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp098_hive.2: A mature hive sometimes breathes out drifting clouds of yellow spores. Staff are advised to keep well back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp098_hive.3: Its residents come and go, and they come back heavier. A well-fed hive does not stay alone for long.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp098_hive.4: Breaking it lets out whatever is inside, and they do not take it well. It leaves only sand behind.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp098_crab_spawn: SCP-098: a spider crab with a cream and orange shell and long banded legs. It has %s health and %s armour.
It lives in an SCP-098-1 hive and leaves it to hunt livestock, then picks the remains clean and carries them home.
It leaves people alone unless they hurt it. Then every crab nearby joins in.
Pale instances have only just arrived, and make straight for their hive. Their colour comes back in time.
